subject: Demo follow-up: proposed POC action plan & success metrics
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rizzo <elena.rizzo@zenworks.com>, Marco Rossi <m.rossi@zenworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:15:00-05:00
Subject: Demo follow-up: proposed POC action plan & success metrics

Hi Elena / Marco,

Thanks again for taking the time today — we appreciated the thoughtful questions and the clear outline of ZenWorks' short-term priorities (entity extraction for contracts, response latency for in-product search). As promised, here's a concise proposed plan for a 3-week POC so you can evaluate performance and operational fit.

High-level objective:
- Validate that Redwood can deliver sub-150ms median token latency for your typical 1k-context search flows while meeting accuracy thresholds for entity extraction across the 3 sample contracts you shared.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm / adjust):
1) Latency: median per-token latency <= 150ms; 95th percentile <= 350ms under 1x baseline load
2) Extraction quality: F1 >= 0.78 on the labeled contract set (we'll provide an evaluation harness)
3) Cost: inference cost per 1k tokens <= target you specify (we can measure and report)
4) Reliability: no more than two transient errors per 10k requests during the trial window

Timeline and ownership:
- Week 0 (kickoff): sign simplified SOW + data transfer. Owners: ZenWorks product (Marco), Redwood AE (Rafael), Redwood SE (Marissa)
- Week 1: model selection + baseline runs (Marissa)
- Week 2: integrate SDK + run evaluation harness (ZenWorks + Marissa)
- Week 3: final report and next-steps review (Rafael + Marco)

Deliverables:
- Evaluation harness (automated scripts + metrics dashboard)
- Baseline latency/cost report and optimized config recommendations (batching/quantization)
- Short executive summary with acceptance decision checklist

Attachments: POC_outline_ZenWorks_v1.pdf (outline + eval plan), redwood_trial_terms.pdf (trial credit & simplified terms)

Ask: Please confirm the success criteria above (especially the cost target and the labeled contract set for F1), and whether we should shorten the scope to a single contract for Week 1 to accelerate results.

If that looks good I’ll loop in Legal for a simple SOW and propose kickoff slots (Dec 1 / Dec 2).

Best,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

--

Attachment: redwood_trial_terms.pdf (pdf, 24KB)
From: Elena Rizzo <elena.rizzo@zenworks.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@zenworks.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T10:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: proposed POC action plan & success metrics

Rafael — thanks, this is a helpful, concrete plan. Quick clarifications from our side: 

Thanks for the recap. A couple of asks/constraints before we lock scope: 
- Scope: Can we phase the POC so Week 1 focuses only on entity extraction (one contract type) and Week 2 expands to search latency measurement? We want a quick win to show Product.
- Cost metric: instead of a hard number, we'd like a baseline measurement and a projected cost curve under 10k, 50k, and 200k monthly requests.
- Data residency: our legal team requires that logs and inference artifacts from the trial remain in the EU region (we are a EU entity). Can Redwood run the trial nodes in eu-west-1?

Also, two follow-ups from Marco: he asked whether model variants will be part of the evaluation (small/medium/quantized).

If you can confirm the phased scope, EU residency, and that we'll get a cost-by-volume report, we'll be ready to kickoff on Dec 2.

Elena
Head of Product, ZenWorks
elena.rizzo@zenworks.com

Date: 2026-11-28T11:20:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: Demo follow-up: proposed POC action plan & success metrics

Rafael / Ben — looping you both in with Elena's note. Response draft below I'm happy to send from Rafael once we align on EU residency and metrics.

Draft reply points (internal):
- EU region: confirmed — Redwood Private/Hosted can pin trial nodes to eu-west-1; we'll add a region flag in the trial config.
- Phased scope: agree to phase Week 1 for extraction on single contract to get a quick baseline. Week 2 expand to latency + cost evaluation.
- Model variants: we will run three variants: base (fp16), medium-quant (4-bit quantized), and a distilled variant for latency comparison. We'll include clear labels in the harness.
- Cost-by-volume: we can produce a cost projection table at 10k/50k/200k monthly requests using the same token assumptions as the doc.
- Offer: propose 20% trial credit on the first month for ZenWorks (commercial discretion) — Rafael to confirm.

Next steps I recommend we:
1) Rafael confirms the offer and sends the updated POC outline to Elena with pinned dates (Dec 2 kickoff)
2) Ben to flag to Legal to prepare simplified SOW + redlines for trial terms
3) I (Marissa) will prepare the evaluation harness and initial model list so we can run Week 1 within 48 hours of kickoff.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Elena / Marco — thanks for the quick replies and the preference for a phased approach. Confirming the plan below so we can get DocuSign and kickoff on Dec 2: 

What we agreed:
- Phased scope: Week 1 = entity extraction on one contract type (baseline labeling + F1 target). Week 2 = latency & cost evaluation across sample traffic patterns. Week 3 = final report.
- Region: Redwood will pin the trial to eu-west-1 and ensure logs/inference artifacts remain in-region for the trial period.
- Model variants: we'll test base (fp16), medium-quant (4-bit), and distilled for latency comparisons.
- Cost analysis: Marissa will supply a cost table at 10k/50k/200k monthly request volumes.
- Commercial: Redwood is prepared to extend a 20% trial credit for the first month contingent on a signed simple SOW.

Action items / next steps:
1) Marco — can you confirm the single contract sample (file name and owner) we should use for Week 1?
2) Marco / Elena — please sign the simplified SOW (DocuSign link below) so Legal can provision the trial environment.
3) Marissa will share the evaluation harness repo and expected telemetry within 24 hours of kickoff.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/s/RW-5683-ZW-SOW
Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-poc-zenworks

If Dec 2 still works for you I'll lock a kickoff slot at 09:00 CET and send a calendar invite.

Best regards,
Rafael
